title: Trump and Xi talk Iran war
gist: Middle East Minute podcast stub: although titled 'Trump and Xi talk Iran war', the available description only says Turkey agreed to withdraw from a key base in Iraq and Yemen pleaded for US help against the Iran-backed Houthis; no Trump-Xi content is in the text.

insights.claim: Turkey agreed to withdraw from a key base in Iraq.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: A Turkish military drawdown in Iraq shifts the northern Iraq security balance.
insights.quote: Turkey agreed to withdraw from a key base in Iraq

insights.claim: Yemen pleaded for US help in the fight against the Iran-backed Houthis.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Signals the Yemeni government losing ground to the Houthis, a risk to Red Sea shipping.
